verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right banner flow with a clear headline block and a strong CTA, but the SOLSTICE logo and the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon are shrunk to near-illegible scraps in the top right, the bottle is jammed against the left edge, and the oversized CTA competes with the headline. In B the one-line headline runs almost into the CTA, which is cramped and pushed hard against the right edge. B's sale ribbon is also orphaned at the bottom-left under the legal line, far from the brand and headline, which breaks the reading order and hierarchy.
